operators.name: channel_mean_forward
semantics: Computes the mean of the input tensor over dimensions 1, 2, and 3 (channels, height, width) for each batch element, keeping dimensions.
Output shape is [N, 1, 1, 1] with dtype float32 on CUDA.
Input is assumed contiguous and float32.

operators.name: subtract_mean_forward
semantics: Performs elementwise subtraction: output = x - mean - subtract_value, broadcasting mean over channels, height, width.
mean tensor has shape [N,1,1,1] and is broadcast across all spatial dims and channels.
subtract_value is a scalar float (self.subtract_mean parameter value).
Output shape same as input x, dtype float32, contiguous.
Compute mean over dimensions 1,2,3, keeping dimensions, for each batch element.
Broadcast mean to x shape, subtract mean and scalar subtract_mean.
Output shape same as x, float32.
